files.summary: SiteDocument is a class representing the relationship between a document and a site in the HSPnet system. It mainly tracks IDs for reference without business logic.
files.purpose: To associate documents with sites for organization, retrieval, and management within HSPnet.
content_gaps: No workflow or usage logic present; only a class definition.

files.summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page that welcomes staff and provides last login information, date filters, site and discipline selection, and displays submitted employment applications with validation and filtering.
files.purpose: To welcome staff and act as an entry point for employment application review with filtering options and validation.

workflows.name: View Employment Application Submissions
steps: Staff arrives at WelcomeStaffAdmin page.
System displays a personalized welcome and last login info.
Staff uses dropdowns to filter by Site and Discipline.
Staff enters Start and End Date filters.
System validates required date fields and date format.
System ensures End Date is not before Start Date.
Staff may show/hide withdrawn applications by checkbox.
Staff clicks to refresh view; data grid shows matching applications with fields for name (with email), program, site, status, withdrawn date.

business_rules: End Date must not be before Start Date.
Start Date and End Date are required.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator on Start Date and End Date.
CustomValidator ensures End Date not before Start Date.
conditions: Display withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
system_behavior: Grid supports paging, shows up to 50 records per page.
No data message if no results.
Data is refreshed when filters or criteria change.
dependencies: Dropdowns populated by Sites.GetByAgencyID and Disciplines.DisciplineList.
Employs Session and User information for personalized content and security.
Uses AjaxControlToolkit extensions for UI elements.
exceptions: Initial population uses current AgencyID. If a SiteID is in query string, defaults to that site.

files.summary: ServiceCode defines a code system with categories, names, and sorting for use in HSPnet. ServiceCodes are loaded by stored procedures and support alternate language fields.
files.purpose: To manage and retrieve lists of service codes, which are key for categorizing, selecting, and localizing services within HSPnet workflows.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with user session.
Call database procedure ServiceCodeListAll.
Read and localize codes as needed.
Return list to caller.

workflows.name: List ASM Service Codes by Course or Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
Pass session and relevant ID as parameters.
Load data from stored procedures, localize, and return.

business_rules: If alt-language mode is active, use alt-language fields.
system_behavior: Service codes are sorted as defined by SortOrder.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.

files.summary: SiteProfileHistory records and displays historical changes to site profiles. Each entry logs who made a change, when, what section, what kind of action, what fields, and agency details.
files.purpose: To provide a searchable, displayable audit/history of changes made to site profiles, supporting accountability, traceability, and review.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: User triggers a search with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
System runs SiteProfileHistorySearch stored procedure.
Results are displayed in a grid.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is active, alt-language field variants are used.
SysAdmin/original user handling for audit trail.
calculations: Formatted agency user details are generated for tooltip display.
system_behavior: Displays audit entries with details for name, agency, phone.
Shows support/special handling if performed by a sysadmin.

files.summary: EmailPopupDocument represents an email-related file (name and path) used in popup dialogs, with support for searching and deleting files, typically as part of email workflows.
files.purpose: Encapsulate file data for popup-based email attachments or linked files, with utility for parsing file info and deleting files from disk.

workflows.name: Search for EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Input DataInfo string (pipe and > delimited).
Parse data into file entries.
Return file entry list.

workflows.name: Delete an EmailPopupDocument
steps: Locate entry by array ID.
Delete physical file and directory if exists.
Return updated DataInfo string without deleted entry.

system_behavior: File deletion attempts are wrapped in try/catch to silently continue on error.
exceptions: Exceptions in file operations are swallowed (not raised).
content_gaps: Does not specify interface or UI triggering email popup or file selection.
